!3 Text: line patterns
Wildcards work inside a line: !-${any}-! any characters (even none), !-${any-string}-! at least one, !-${any-number}-! a decimal number, !-${regex:P}-! a fragment matching P. Everything else is literal, regex characters included; !-$${…}-! is a literal !-${…}-!. A line holding only !-${ignore}-! is optional. Trailing spaces and CRLF do not count; blank lines at the end are ignored, other blank lines count.
